summary: awx.awx was removed from Ansible 14 because of heavy refactoring, and the deprecated cisco.dnac and junipernetworks.junos collections were removed.
questions: Why was awx.awx removed from Ansible 14?

answer_card.title: Why awx.awx, cisco.dnac and junos were removed
answer_card.answer_md:
- **awx.awx:** removed because it is being heavily refactored and doesn't meet community package standards. Install with `ansible-galaxy collection install awx.awx`.
- **cisco.dnac** and **junipernetworks.junos:** previously deprecated, now removed.
